news.headline: Delhi's anti-pollution drive collects ₹68.4 lakh in fines on Day 1, sends back 1,539 vehicles
news.story_lead: Delhi's anti-pollution drive collects ₹68.4 lakh in fines on Day 1, sends back 1,539 vehicles To curb air pollution, the Delhi government has imposed restrictions, including a ban on non-Delhi vehicles below BS-VI emission standards till 31, 2027. Delhi enforcement drive under the winter action plan resulted in penalties and environmental compensation amounting to ₹ 68.4 lakh on its first day. Authorities inspected close to 15,000 vehicles at various checkpoints, sent back 1,539 vehicles at the city’s borders and issued 566 challans for failing to comply with Pollution Under Control Certificate (PUCC) requirements.
news.full_article_text: Delhi's anti-pollution drive collects ₹68.4 lakh in fines on Day 1, sends back 1,539 vehicles To curb air pollution, the Delhi government has imposed restrictions, including a ban on non-Delhi vehicles below BS-VI emission standards till 31, 2027. Delhi enforcement drive under the winter action plan resulted in penalties and environmental compensation amounting to ₹ 68.4 lakh on its first day. Authorities inspected close to 15,000 vehicles at various checkpoints, sent back 1,539 vehicles at the city’s borders and issued 566 challans for failing to comply with Pollution Under Control Certificate (PUCC) requirements. To curb air pollution, the Delhi government has imposed several restrictions, including a ban on non-Delhi vehicles that do not meet BS-VI emission standards from November 1, 2026, to January 31, 2027, and a directive prohibiting fuel stations from dispensing fuel to vehicles without a valid PUCC. ₹ 56.6 lakh in penalties for PUCC violations Data released by officials up to 5 pm on Sunday showed that the largest share of the collection came from PUCC-related violations, attracting fines of ₹ 56.6 lakh, news agency PTI reported. Moreover, ₹ 2 lakh was imposed for breaching restrictions on vehicle entry into Delhi, while construction- and demolition-related violations accounted for ₹ 9.8 lakh in environmental compensation. Deep Dive As part of restrictions targeting non-Delhi-registered vehicles that do not meet BS-VI emission standards, the Delhi traffic police and transport department jointly inspected 14,930 vehicles. Of these, around 10.31 per cent were denied entry and directed to return at the border checkpoints. Delhi traffic police face marginal staff shortage amid INDIA bloc’s rally During a spot check by HT at three border points - the Delhi-Noida Direct (DND) Flyway, Chilla village, and the Kalindi Kunj border, a Delhi traffic police personnel said they faced a marginal staff shortage due to the INDIA bloc’s rally at Ramlila Maidan. However, they said the situation remained manageable. ALSO READ: Traffic snarls, 'frustrated' public: Anti-pollution restrictions kick in as Delhi's AQI turns 'poor' “In around five hours, we sent back around six vehicles which were non-Delhi registered and BS-IV. Many had only one vehicle and were headed to places where public transport does not provide last-mile connectivity. We suggested they take the metro as far as possible,” said Pankaj Rana, a Delhi traffic police personnel. He further said around nine personnel were deployed at the Kalindi Kunj entry point, including two police officers, three transport department officials, and five traffic police personnel. However, during HT’s nearly 40-minute visit, only two personnel were seen checking vehicles. ALSO READ: Delhi air quality takes a nosedive ahead of Diwali, anti-pollution curbs kick in Unis Saifi, a 31-year-old Delhi resident who works in Noida, said, “The bike that I own is BS-IV, and registered in Delhi. I had to go to Noida for some work, but was not sure if I would be allowed. So I took an Uber instead.” Govt, private offices on 50 per cent wfh arrangement Government and private offices are also required to limit physical attendance to 50 per cent from November 1 to January 31, with the remaining employees working from home. Essential and emergency services have been exempted. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR HT News Desk Follow the latest breaking news, major developments and agenda-setting stories from India and around the world with the newsdesk at Hindustan Times. news.headline: DJB plans ₹149 crore sewer line through Yamuna floodplain to curb sewage overflows
news.story_lead: DJB plans ₹149 crore sewer line through Yamuna floodplain to curb sewage overflows The upcoming 1,800mm-diameter pipeline has received administrative approval of its estimated cost of ₹ 148.90 crore from the DJB board, according to the project details The Delhi Jal Board (DJB) plans to lay an 8.34-km sewer rising main through the Yamuna’s ecologically sensitive floodplain to carry sewage from the Ring Road pumping station to the Okhla sewage treatment plant (STP). The upcoming 1,800mm-diameter pipeline has received administrative approval of its estimated cost of ₹ 148.90 crore from the DJB board, according to the project details. The civic utility says the new line will help address recurring sewage overflows caused by three ageing gravity ducts, built in 1938, 1972 and 1992, which have become inadequate and silted up.

news.headline: China state broadcaster pulls La Liga matches following Mbappé joke
news.story_lead: China Media Group, which acknowledged MbappÃ©'s apology, has not commented on how long the blackout will last - Published 2 hours ago China's state broadcaster CCTV did not air a Real Madrid match on Sunday, despite the club's star striker Kylian MbappÃ©'s apology for his "ill-judged" remarks on the late Chinese leader Mao Zedong. MbappÃ© drew huge backlash after saying the meme "that makes [him] laugh the most" was the one in which his face is superimposed on a "Chinese dictator" resembling Mao. China Media Group, CCTV's parent organisation, said last Tuesday it would suspend broadcasts of Spanish football La Liga matches following the furore, which also led to MbappÃ© being dropped by several Chinese brands.
news.full_article_text: China Media Group, which acknowledged MbappÃ©'s apology, has not commented on how long the blackout will last - Published 2 hours ago China's state broadcaster CCTV did not air a Real Madrid match on Sunday, despite the club's star striker Kylian MbappÃ©'s apology for his "ill-judged" remarks on the late Chinese leader Mao Zedong. MbappÃ© drew huge backlash after saying the meme "that makes [him] laugh the most" was the one in which his face is superimposed on a "Chinese dictator" resembling Mao. China Media Group, CCTV's parent organisation, said last Tuesday it would suspend broadcasts of Spanish football La Liga matches following the furore, which also led to MbappÃ© being dropped by several Chinese brands. China's foreign ministry had said it took MbappÃ©'s apology "seriously". Real Madrid and La Liga have also apologised. China Media Group had earlier demanded apologies from the three parties, calling them "an absolute prerequisite" for moving past the incident. It has acknowledged the apologies, but has not commented on how long the broadcast blackout will last. MbappÃ©, who reportedly made his remark about the meme on French talk show The Bridge, apologised later on Tuesday. "My comment was ill-judged, and I now understand that it hurt many people in China and in Chinese communities around the world," he had said. The joke did not go down well in China, where Mao is revered by the Communist Party, despite his having overseen one of the bloodiest chapters in the country's past. Mao, who led the Chinese Communist Party to victory in the civil war and founded the People's Republic of China, died in 1976. During his rule he oversaw the Great Leap Forward and the Cultural Revolution, which led to a famine that killed tens of millions and unleashed violent purges across Chinese society. This is not the first time Beijing has suspended sports broadcasts over political sensitivities. It pulled NBA games for a year from October 2019 after Daryl Morey, the general manager of Houston Rockets, tweeted in support of Hong Kong protesters during widespread pro-democracy protests in the city. Morey backtracked on his comment after fierce criticism from Chinese fans, sponsors and commercial partners. "I have had a lot of opportunity since that tweet to hear and consider other perspectives," Morey later wrote. "I have always appreciated the significant support our Chinese fans and sponsors...I would hope that those who are upset will know that offending or misunderstanding them was not my intention." Real Madrid beat Racing Santander 3-0 in Sunday's match, with goals from MbappÃ©, Jude Bellingham and Yan Diomande. Related topics

news.headline: Open-top overlanders: Show of Opposition unity at their largest mobilisation in recent years
news.story_lead: Open-top overlanders: Show of Opposition unity at their largest mobilisation in recent years The overlanders brought together leaders from the INDIA bloc for the march and a rally at Ramlila Maidan On October 12, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi led thousands of marchers from atop a modified truck as they flooded central Delhi for hours to protest alleged irregularities in the Election Commission of India (ECI)’s functioning and the electoral roll special intensive revision (SIR). Two air-conditioned buses were kept as backup. Around three weeks later, Congress-led Opposition Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA) leaders opted for open-top overlanders from Rajasthan, used in jungle safaris, as they renewed demands for Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar’s removal.
news.full_article_text: Open-top overlanders: Show of Opposition unity at their largest mobilisation in recent years The overlanders brought together leaders from the INDIA bloc for the march and a rally at Ramlila Maidan On October 12, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi led thousands of marchers from atop a modified truck as they flooded central Delhi for hours to protest alleged irregularities in the Election Commission of India (ECI)’s functioning and the electoral roll special intensive revision (SIR). Two air-conditioned buses were kept as backup. Around three weeks later, Congress-led Opposition Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA) leaders opted for open-top overlanders from Rajasthan, used in jungle safaris, as they renewed demands for Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar’s removal. The overlanders were more than a mode of transport. People aware of the matter said they symbolised Opposition unity. The overlanders brought together leaders from the INDIA bloc for the march and a rally at Ramlila Maidan, one of the three newly designated protest sites in the Capital, against alleged electoral irregularities. Deep Dive One of the overlanders joined the march at Minto Road, around 1.3 kilometers from Ramlila Maidan. The other two started from Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s residence, where several top leaders had assembled. The Opposition march and rally were the largest show of INDIA bloc strength. The bloc has been pushing for Kumar’s removal, demanding accountability for the removal of 130 million names from electoral rolls, many of them under absent, shifted, or dead categories, as part of SIR. Among those who joined the procession were Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav, Trinamool Congress leaders Mamata Banerjee and Abhishek Banerjee, Communist Party of India (Marxist) leader M A Baby, Communist Party of India general secretary D Raja, National Conference president Farooq Abdullah and Peoples Democratic Party’s Mehbooba Mufti. INDIA bloc leaders came together for the largest Opposition mobilisation in recent years and said Kumar will be jailed for treason in the future. The march snaked through central Delhi for over an hour before a rally. Rahul Gandhi attacked the government, saying Prime Minister Narendra Modi and home minister Amit Shah will not be allowed to escape the law. He called Kumar’s removal the first step to bring the country back on track. The march began from the edge of Connaught Place to Ramlila Maidan for the rally, where nine leaders spoke The protests were sparked after an Indian Express investigation found Election Commissioners SS Sandhu and Vivek Joshi recorded written dissents and objections at least 14 times between November 2025 and August 2026 and even wrote to the cabinet secretary. Election officials allegedly found their access to the ECI software curtailed by the central IT team. ECI said differing views and observations were a normal part of deliberation and that all its digital platforms operated under strict data security protocols. Over the past month, thousands of people have hit the streets, despite Metro closures, internet shutdown and prohibitory orders. In October, around 40,000 security personnel turned the Capital into a virtual fortress and sparked controversy by dragging, manhandling, and detaining many agitators. The ruling Bharatiya Janata Party has called the calls for Kumar’s removal and SIR scrapping part of attempts to destabilise constitutional bodies to deflect attention from failures of the Opposition parties. - Election Commission Of India

news.story_lead: Big blow to AAP as three MLAs join BJP ahead of 2027 Punjab Assembly elections The leaders arrived at the BJP Headquarters in Delhi and were seen raising slogans of “BJP Zindabad” ahead of officially joining the party. In a big blow to the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) ahead of the 2027 assembly elections, three of its legislators, Harmeet Singh Pathanmajra, Chetan Singh Jouramajra, and Kunwar Vijay Pratap Singh, joined the Bharatiya Janata Party on Monday. Pathanmajra and Jouramajra resigned from the party on Sunday .
news.full_article_text: Big blow to AAP as three MLAs join BJP ahead of 2027 Punjab Assembly elections The leaders arrived at the BJP Headquarters in Delhi and were seen raising slogans of “BJP Zindabad” ahead of officially joining the party. In a big blow to the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) ahead of the 2027 assembly elections, three of its legislators, Harmeet Singh Pathanmajra, Chetan Singh Jouramajra, and Kunwar Vijay Pratap Singh, joined the Bharatiya Janata Party on Monday. Pathanmajra and Jouramajra resigned from the party on Sunday . Meanwhile, Singh tendered his resignation from the party on Monday. The resignations came after the AAP released its first list of 40 candidates for the 2027 assembly elections. The party, however, had not announced candidates for either Sanaur or Samana, the constituencies represented by the Pathanmajra and Jouramajra. Pathanmajra, the MLA from Sanaur, submitted his resignation to AAP national convener Arvind Kejriwal, quitting the party with immediate effect. Former cabinet minister and Samana MLA Jouramajra also announced his resignation through a social media post. Confirming their move to the BJP, Pathanmajra said both leaders would be formally inducted into the party by BJP president Nitin Nabin in Delhi on Monday. Explaining his decision, Pathanmajra said the BJP, being a national party, could bring significant benefits to Punjab if it came to power in the state. He also pointed to the party's commitment to eliminating drugs, citing Union home minister Amit Shah's recent announcement on the issue. After quitting the AAP, both leaders launched a scathing attack on the party's leadership, alleging that its Delhi-based leaders, particularly Kejriwal and his close aide Bibhav Kumar, were interfering in Punjab's governance. They also accused the state government of failing on several fronts, citing alleged corruption, rising crime, snatching incidents, extortion, gang violence and murders. They further questioned the government's failure to fulfil its promise of making Punjab drug-free. The AAP on Monday requested the Speaker to cancel the Assembly membership of both leaders. It added that the two had already been suspended from the party for alleged anti-party activities. Following their suspension, both leaders resigned from the party, news agency ANI reported. Singh’s resignation Sharing a copy of his resignation sent to Punjab assembly speaker Kultar Singh Sandhwan, Singh in a Facebook post said, “I have resigned from the membership of the Punjab Legislative Assembly. I will remain indebted to you until my last breath for the love and respect you have given me,” he said. Singh is widely known for his dissenting views and was suspended from the ruling AAP for five years in June. An IPS officer, he headed the Special Investigation Team (SIT) probing the post-sacrilege police firing incidents in 2015, in which two Sikh protesters were killed. “With your cooperation and God's blessings, rising above the politics of streets, drains, and ribbon-cutting, we all must make a united effort to rebuild Punjab—currently trapped in the grips of drugs, extortion, gang culture, and corruption—into a progressive and leading state once again,” he added. “As you all know, I have accomplished 90 percent of my targets as an MLA, covering the work that an MLA is supposed to do. The duties of a councilor, mayor, and Member of Parliament are separate from this. I have also provided a detailed account of the works carried out area-wise through my efforts, which is available in newspapers and on my Facebook page.” The former IPS officer had joined the AAP ahead of the 2022 Assembly elections in the presence of the party's national convenor, Arvind Kejriwal. “Moving forward, formulating a strategy together with you to ensure clean politics and a transparent administration will be my objective. My sole purpose is ‘Punjab First’. Other than that, I have no personal self-interest,” he added. The resignations have highlighted the growing differences within the Punjab AAP unit, particularly over constituency-level appointments and the party leadership’s electoral strategy. * **Military Demands:** President Volodymyr Zelensky requested the provision of Patriot missile defense systems to bolster Ukrainian defensive capabilities.
* **US Strategic Request:** US President Donald Trump requested that Ukrainian forces avoid targeting Russian oil refineries and energy infrastructure.
* **Diplomatic Context:** The request reflects international concerns regarding the global energy market stability alongside ongoing air defense support demands from Ukraine.

hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### फ्लोरिडा जेट दुर्घटना मामला

अमेरिका के फ्लोरिडा स्थित एक आवासीय पड़ोस में एक जेट विमान दुर्घटनाग्रस्त हो गया। तीव्र टक्कर के कारण जमीन में एक विशाल गड्ढा बन गया। दुर्घटना के अंतिम पलों के वीडियो और प्रत्यक्षदर्शियों के बयान सामने आए हैं।

**घटना के मुख्य बिंदु:**
- **स्थान**: फ्लोरिडा, संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका का एक आवासीय क्षेत्र।
- **प्रभाव**: अत्यधिक गति के कारण टक्कर स्थल पर गहरा गड्ढा बन गया।
- **प्रत्यक्षदर्शियों के विवरण**: प्रत्यक्षदर्शियों के अनुसार विमान अत्यधिक गति और तीखे कोण से नीचे गिर रहा था, जो देखने में मिसाइल जैसा प्रतीत हो रहा था।
- **जांच की दिशा**: विमानन सुरक्षा अधिकारी और आपातकालीन दल उड़ान के अंतिम क्षणों की जांच और कारणों का पता लगाने में जुटे हैं।
bullet_points: अमेरिका के फ्लोरिडा में एक पड़ोस में जेट विमान दुर्घटनाग्रस्त हुआ।
तेज गति से हुई टक्कर के कारण आवासीय क्षेत्र में एक विशाल गड्ढा बन गया।
प्रत्यक्षदर्शियों ने विमान के गिरने की दिशा को मिसाइल जैसा बताया।
वीडियो फुटेज में दुर्घटना से पहले विमान की तीखी गिरावट दर्ज की गई।

यह घटना आवासीय क्षेत्रों के ऊपर विमानन सुरक्षा से जुड़ी चिंताओं को रेखांकित करती है।

news.headline: Google Activates First AI Processing Unit in Orbit and Plans 2027 Satellite Launch
news.story_lead: Google has successfully booted up its first Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) in Earth orbit and executed its initial artificial intelligence prompt. According to Google CEO Sundar Pichai, the test returned a haiku poem, marking a significant step in testing AI microprocessors under extreme space environments. The company is evaluating chip performance under strict power limits and cosmic radiation, with plans to launch two laser-linked 'Suncatcher' satellites in 2027.
news.full_article_text:
### Google Activates First Space-Based AI Microprocessor

Google has successfully tested its proprietary artificial intelligence hardware in space. Alphabet and Google Chief Executive Officer Sundar Pichai confirmed that orbital controllers transmitted a operational command, successfully booted up a Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) in orbit, and processed an AI prompt that generated a poem (haiku) back to Earth.

### Primary Operational Challenges: Power and Radiation

Deploying advanced AI computing microchips into space introduces severe physical and technical hurdles. The main tests currently being conducted on the orbital TPU involve:
- **Power Constraints:** Evaluating chip energy consumption and efficiency within the limited power generation capabilities of satellite platforms.
- **Radiation Tolerance:** Assessing the resilience of silicon architecture against high-energy cosmic radiation, which can disrupt electronic circuits and cause calculation errors.

### Future Roadmap: Project Suncatcher (2027)

Following the successful activation of its initial orbital TPU, Google is planning to expand its space-based hardware infrastructure. The company plans to launch two additional satellites under Project 'Suncatcher' in 2027. These upcoming satellites will be equipped with inter-satellite laser communications links to test network synchronization and in-orbit data processing capabilities.
bullet_points: Google successfully sent a command to Earth orbit to boot up its first space-deployed Tensor Processing Unit (TPU).
The AI chip completed its first task by responding to a prompt with a written poem (haiku).
Google CEO Sundar Pichai highlighted the achievement as a key operational milestone.
Primary orbital testing focuses on power usage efficiency and resistance to space radiation.
Google plans to deploy two more satellites, known as Suncatcher satellites, in 2027.
The 2027 Suncatcher satellites will feature inter-satellite laser communication links.

However, operating complex microprocessors in space presents major engineering challenges, primarily cosmic radiation-induced bit flips and hardware degradation, as well as strict thermal and power limits aboard small satellites.

hindi_translation.headline: गूगल ने अंतरिक्ष कक्षा में अपना पहला एआई प्रोसेसर सक्रिय किया, 2027 में दो उपग्रह लॉन्च करने की योजना
hindi_translation.story_lead: गूगल ने पृथ्वी की कक्षा में अपने पहले टेंसर प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट (TPU) को सफलतापूर्वक बूट अप किया और अपना पहला कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) प्रॉम्प्ट निष्पादित किया। गूगल के सीईओ सुंदर पिचाई के अनुसार, इस परीक्षण के तहत एक हाइकु कविता प्राप्त हुई, जो अंतरिक्ष के कठिन वातावरण में एआई माइक्रोप्रोसेसरों के परीक्षण में एक महत्वपूर्ण मील का पत्थर है। कंपनी वर्तमान में सीमित बिजली और अंतरिक्ष विकिरण के तहत चिप के प्रदर्शन का आकलन कर रही है और 2027 में लेजर-लिंक वाले दो 'सनकैचर' उपग्रहों को लॉन्च करने की योजना बना रही है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### गूगल ने अंतरिक्ष में पहला एआई माइक्रोप्रोसेसर सक्रिय किया

गूगल ने अंतरिक्ष में अपने स्वदेशी कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) हार्डवेयर का सफलतापूर्वक परीक्षण किया है। अल्फाबेट और गूगल के मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी (सीईओ) सुंदर पिचाई ने पुष्टि की कि ऑर्बिटल कंट्रोलर्स ने एक परिचालन कमान भेजी, कक्षा में टेंसर प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट (TPU) को सफलतापूर्वक चालू किया, और एक एआई प्रॉम्प्ट को निष्पादित कर उत्तर के रूप में एक कविता (हाइकु) प्राप्त की।

### मुख्य तकनीकी चुनौतियाँ: ऊर्जा और विकिरण

अंतरिक्ष में उन्नत एआई कंप्यूटिंग माइक्रोचिप्स को तैनात करने में गंभीर भौतिक और तकनीकी चुनौतियाँ शामिल हैं। कक्षा में स्थित टीपीयू पर किए जा रहे प्रमुख परीक्षण निम्नलिखित हैं:
- **ऊर्जा प्रबंधन:** उपग्रह प्लेटफॉर्मों की सीमित बिजली उत्पादन क्षमताओं के भीतर चिप की ऊर्जा खपत और दक्षता का मूल्यांकन करना।
- **विकिरण सहनशीलता:** उच्च-ऊर्जा ब्रह्मांडीय विकिरण के खिलाफ सिलिकॉन आर्किटेक्चर के लचीलेपन का आकलन करना, जो इलेक्ट्रॉनिक सर्किट को बाधित कर सकता है और गणना में त्रुटियां पैदा कर सकता है।

### भविष्य की योजना: प्रोजेक्ट सनकैचर (2027)

अपने शुरुआती ऑर्बिटल टीपीयू के सफल संचालन के बाद, गूगल अपने अंतरिक्ष-आधारित हार्डवेयर बुनियादी ढांचे का विस्तार करने की योजना बना रहा है। कंपनी 2027 में 'सनकैचर' प्रोजेक्ट के तहत दो अतिरिक्त उपग्रह लॉन्च करने की योजना बना रही है। इन आगामी उपग्रहों में अंतर-उपग्रह लेजर संचार लिंक शामिल होंगे ताकि नेटवर्क सिंक्रोनाइज़ेशन और इन-ऑर्बिट डेटा प्रोसेसिंग क्षमताओं का परीक्षण किया जा सके।
bullet_points: गूगल ने पृथ्वी की कक्षा में अपने पहले टेंसर प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट (TPU) को चालू करने के लिए सफलतापूर्वक कमांड भेजी।
एआई चिप ने एक प्रॉम्प्ट के जवाब में एक हाइकु कविता जनरेट करके अपना पहला कार्य पूरा किया।

news.headline: Democrat endorses Republican candidate in key Michigan Senate race as party spat erupts
news.story_lead: Haley Stevens, a sitting Democratic congresswoman, appeared alongside the Republican Senate candidate on Sunday - Published 1 November 2026, 18:24 GMT A Democrat in Michigan has endorsed the Republican candidate in the state's crucial US Senate contest, as a spat with her own party's candidate Abdul El-Sayed escalated just days before the vote. Haley Stevens, a sitting congresswoman who lost out on the Democratic Senate nomination to El-Sayed, made a surprise appearance alongside the Republican candidate Mike Rogers on Sunday. "I don't belong in Abdul's campaign," she said in a video posted to X shortly after that appearance.
news.full_article_text: Haley Stevens, a sitting Democratic congresswoman, appeared alongside the Republican Senate candidate on Sunday - Published 1 November 2026, 18:24 GMT A Democrat in Michigan has endorsed the Republican candidate in the state's crucial US Senate contest, as a spat with her own party's candidate Abdul El-Sayed escalated just days before the vote. Haley Stevens, a sitting congresswoman who lost out on the Democratic Senate nomination to El-Sayed, made a surprise appearance alongside the Republican candidate Mike Rogers on Sunday. "I don't belong in Abdul's campaign," she said in a video posted to X shortly after that appearance. "Who we are as Michiganders is not hate and is not what we are getting out from our Democratic nominee right now." "That's why I am endorsing Mike Rogers," Stevens said. The move stunned many of Stevens' fellow Democrats who condemned her decision to break from the party and switch her support just two days before the election. The public feud between Stevens, a centrist Democrat, and El-Sayed, who represents the party's left-wing, has boiled over in recent days. They clashed publicly over a campaign advert from an outside liberal group which blamed Israel for high food prices. El-Sayed criticised the advert and said he had nothing to do with its contents. Stevens had been scheduled to appear at an event with El-Sayed on Sunday in an effort to display party unity, but he reportedly asked her not to come and she chose to attend a church service with his Republican opponent instead. "This is a very close election, we all know that, but Abdul made clear that I was not welcome in his campaign, that he didn't need me there, that he didn't want me there," Stevens told reporters as she stood alongside Rogers outside the church. When asked about Stevens' endorsement, El-Sayed told reporters he was focused on the problems Michiganders are facing. "At the end of the day, I don't think about Haley Stevens," he said on Sunday. "None of this matters." - GUIDE: What are the US midterms? - EXPLAINED: Why Trump's approval rating matters in the midterms - IN DEPTH: The Republicans walking a Trump tightrope The Michigan Senate race is considered by analysts to be one of the tightest in Tuesday's midterm elections. It is one of a handful of battleground contests that will ultimately decide control of the Senate. The seat is currently held by a retiring Democrat and the last time a Republican was elected to this Senate seat was in 1994. But in presidential elections, it is one of the crucial swing states - Michigan voted for Joe Biden in 2020 but Donald Trump in 2024. Rogers welcomed Stevens' endorsement and said it showed "courage" during brief remarks with reporters. President Donald Trump echoed that sentiment, saying on Truth Social that "[Stevens] showed great and almost unprecedented loyalty to the Great People of Michigan with what she did". Many of Stevens' staff reportedly resigned immediately after her announcement, while the chair of the Democratic Party in Michigan said her decision "shows that she has abandoned everything she claims to care about". "We reject the attempts by Stevens and bad-faith actors to divide our party and undermine our momentum," Curtis Hertel said in a statement. What's at stake for Trump in the US midterms? In downtown Detroit, several Democrats the BBC spoke to said they were disappointed by Stevens' endorsement of Rogers. "I just genuinely don't understand it," she said. "I do think it's a betrayal of the party because the things she stands for are not the same things that he stands for as a Republican." "Maybe she had frustrations with the party," Matthew Barera, another Michigan voter, said. Others, including Republicans who support Rogers, said they doubted it would make a difference to the race. "People can see right through her actions, you know? She's just angry," Marissa Lee, a Rogers supporter, told the BBC. "She is not going to make anybody change their mind." Over the weekend, as Stevens' criticism of El-Sayed escalated, a number of Democratic politicians in Michigan publicly encouraged her to end the feud and back the party's candidates more directly. On Sunday, Democratic Senator Chuck Schumer called Stevens' endorsement of Rogers "a despicable betrayal" of her political party. After a bruising and sometimes bitter campaign earlier this year, El-Sayed, a left-wing outsider, defeated Stevens, the establishment-backed congresswoman, to win the party's nomination for the US Senate race. news.headline: Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine as Kherson ceasefire ends
news.story_lead: Emergency responders at the scene of a strike on Ukraine's Vinnytsia region - Published 1 November 2026, 19:48 GMT A rare humanitarian ceasefire in Ukraine's front-line Kherson region that allowed civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky has ended. The localised ceasefire was due to end at 22:59 Ukrainian time (21:00 GMT) on Sunday. While the truce had held since it was implemented last week, fighting had continued elsewhere.
news.full_article_text: Emergency responders at the scene of a strike on Ukraine's Vinnytsia region - Published 1 November 2026, 19:48 GMT A rare humanitarian ceasefire in Ukraine's front-line Kherson region that allowed civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky has ended. The localised ceasefire was due to end at 22:59 Ukrainian time (21:00 GMT) on Sunday. While the truce had held since it was implemented last week, fighting had continued elsewhere. On Sunday evening, Ukraine's air alert system was apparently hacked, the country's air force said, warning of radiation over Kyiv - a reference to a possible nuclear attack. The Air Force message read: "The Air Alarm application has probably been subjected to hostile interference. There is no radiation threat! Stay calm and follow our updates on our channel." Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Russia had struck energy infrastructure in four regions overnight on Saturday, leaving hundreds of thousands of homes without power. Some connections were restored on Sunday. Another overnight strike killed two people, including a 13-year-old girl, in the Vinnytsia region, the State Emergency Service of Ukraine said. Meanwhile, Ukraine hit a major missile fuel producer in Russia's Rostov region, which caused a fire and damaged four production facilities, Zelensky said. In Ukraine, repair works to restore power continued throughout the day. Most customers in the Dnipropetrovsk region had their connections restored by early evening, but more than 60,000 were still without power, the governor said. Because of regular attacks on energy infrastructure, emergency power cuts have been introduced across the country. Even in the capital Kyiv, electricity is cut off for most of the day, and water supplies are also disrupted. Zelensky said in a social media post that the intensity of Russian strikes has been "extremely high" over the past week, adding that Russia was "trying to take maximum advantage of the shortage of ballistic missile interceptors". He added that "every day" Ukraine communicated its need for Patriot missiles - the only effective weapon for downing Russia's deadly ballistic missiles - to the US, Europe and other partners. He thanked countries for their support so far and longer-term commitments, but called again for more immediate aid. Watch: Evacuees from Oleshky reunited with their families The limited pause in hostilities, which started on Tuesday, was brokered with the help of US First Lady Melania Trump and Pope Leo. It was originally confined to the city of Oleshky, which has been occupied by Russia since the first days of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, and was expanded across the wider region of Kherson. Oleshky had been trapped on one side by the Dnipro river and the other by Russian forces, with routes out mined and subject to drone attack. Residents trapped there were suffering severe shortages of food, water and electricity, with many resorting to cooking garden weeds to survive. The truce allowed for Oleskhy residents to evacuate if they wanted, and there were emotional scenes on Saturday of reunions between loved ones who hadn't seen eachother for years. There are Ukrainian military positions just 5km (3.1 miles) from Oleshky, but evacuees had to travel through Russian-occupied territory to southern Russia, where they flew to Belarus, before finally being driven across Ukraine's northern border. The oldest evacuee was 94 years old, while the youngest was one, according to Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine's human rights ombudsman. news.headline: Ukraine Proposes Halting Strikes on Russian Refineries in Exchange for US Missile Supply
news.story_lead: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has stated that Ukraine would cease military attacks on Russian oil refineries if the United States supplies the nation with long-range missiles. The proposal directly connects Ukraine's military target selection with its efforts to secure advanced defence hardware from Washington.
news.full_article_text:
### Proposal on Russian Refinery Attacks and US Missiles

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that Ukraine is prepared to halt its strategic military strikes on Russian oil refineries on the condition that the United States provides long-range missile systems. Over recent months, Ukrainian long-range drone attacks have frequently targeted crude oil processing facilities inside Russia to weaken military fuel logistics and diminish Russian state energy revenues.

### Strategic Context and Key Details

- **Targeting Energy Assets:** Ukraine's attack strategy has focused on disrupting Russia's petroleum refining capacity, aiming to strain logistical support for military forces and reduce export income.
- **Conditionality on US Assistance:** President Zelensky's statement ties the suspension of these targeted operations directly to the procurement of long-range missile systems from the US military.
- **Defense Assistance Diplomacy:** The proposal underscores the diplomatic effort by Kyiv to negotiate crucial long-range defense supplies, which Ukraine considers vital for frontline deterrence and strategic strikes.
bullet_points: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated Ukraine would stop hitting Russian oil refineries if supplied with US missiles.
The proposal creates a explicit condition connecting military targeting strategy to foreign defence supply agreements.
Ukrainian strikes have specifically targeted Russian crude refineries to impact military fuel supply lines.
Attacks on energy infrastructure aim to reduce Russian government revenues derived from oil and fuel exports.
Kyiv has consistently requested long-range missile capabilities from Western allies, particularly the United States.
The condition highlights how target selection is utilized as leverage in international defense aid negotiations.
key_facts: President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed Ukraine's willingness to pause refinery strikes.
Condition precedent: Delivery of long-range missiles by the United States.
Targeted sector: Russian crude oil refineries and processing units.
important_dates: 2026-11-02: Date of statement report regarding Ukraine's conditional proposal to the US
exam_relevance: UPSC CSE General Studies Paper II: Bilateral and multilateral agreements involving major global powers.
UPSC CSE General Studies Paper III: Security challenges, defense diplomacy, and impact of infrastructure targeting on global energy dynamics.
news.upsc_analysis: The statement by the Ukrainian leadership demonstrates the integration of economic warfare and defense procurement diplomacy. Linking operational constraints—such as targeting oil refineries—to the delivery of specific strategic weapon systems like long-range missiles shows how tactical decisions are linked to bilateral security assistance negotiations.
causes: Ukraine's need for advanced long-range missile inventory from the United States.
Ongoing Ukrainian military campaigns focused on disrupting Russian oil refining and military logistics.
impacts: Potential modification of Ukrainian military targeting guidelines regarding Russian energy infrastructure.
Shift in bilateral defense negotiations between Washington and Kyiv regarding long-range weaponry.
challenges: Managing escalation risks associated with long-range missile transfers.
Balancing energy market stability with targeted strikes on crude refining infrastructure.
government_steps: Ukrainian diplomatic outreach to secure conditional missile supply agreements from the US administration.
constitutional_or_policy_link: US Arms Export Control Act and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) policies.
way_forward: Continued diplomatic consultations between Kyiv and Washington to align defence support with strategic conflict objectives.
news.mains_notes: President Zelensky's conditional offer to halt attacks on Russian oil refineries in exchange for US long-range missiles illustrates the connection between operational target selection and strategic defense assistance negotiations in modern armed conflicts.
mains_questions: Discuss the strategic implications of targeting critical energy infrastructure during modern international conflicts.
Examine the role of defense procurement conditionality in military alliance dynamics during prolonged geopolitical crises.
news.takeaway: Ukraine has offered to halt military strikes on Russian oil refineries provided the US supplies long-range missiles.
prelims_facts: Volodymyr Zelensky serves as the President of Ukraine.
Ukraine made halting refinery attacks contingent upon receiving US-supplied missiles.

hindi_translation.headline: यूक्रेन का प्रस्ताव: यदि अमेरिका मिसाइलें प्रदान करता है तो रूस की रिफाइनरियों पर हमले रोकेगा
hindi_translation.story_lead: यूक्रेनी राष्ट्रपति वोलोडिमिर ज़ेलेंस्की ने कहा है कि यदि संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका उनके देश को लंबी दूरी की मिसाइलें प्रदान करता है, तो यूक्रेन रूसी तेल रिफाइनरियों पर अपने सैन्य हमलों को रोक देगा। यह प्रस्ताव यूक्रेन द्वारा अमेरिका से उन्नत रक्षा उपकरण हासिल करने के प्रयासों से जुड़ा है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### रूसी रिफाइनरी हमलों और अमेरिकी मिसाइलों पर प्रस्ताव

यूक्रेनी राष्ट्रपति वोलोडिमिर ज़ेलेंस्की ने घोषणा की कि यूक्रेन रूसी तेल रिफाइनरियों पर अपने रणनीतिक सैन्य हमलों को रोकने के लिए तैयार है, बशर्ते संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका देश को लंबी दूरी की मिसाइल प्रणालियाँ प्रदान करे। हाल के महीनों में, यूक्रेन के ड्रोनों ने सैन्य ईंधन आपूर्ति और रूसी राज्य के ऊर्जा राजस्व को कमजोर करने के लिए रूस के भीतर कच्चे तेल प्रसंस्करण सुविधाओं को निशाना बनाया है।

### रणनीतिक संदर्भ और मुख्य विवरण

- **ऊर्जा संपत्तियों को निशाना बनाना:** यूक्रेन की रणनीति रूसी पेट्रोलियम रिफाइनिंग क्षमता को बाधित करने पर केंद्रित रही है, जिसका उद्देश्य सैन्य बलों के लिए लॉजिस्टिक सहायता को प्रभावित करना है।
- **अमेरिकी सहायता पर शर्त:** ज़ेलेंस्की का बयान सीधे तौर पर वाशिंगटन से लंबी दूरी की मिसाइल प्रणालियों की प्राप्ति से इन हमलों को रोकने की शर्त जोड़ता है।
- **रक्षा सहायता कूटनीति:** यह प्रस्ताव कीव द्वारा लंबी दूरी की रक्षा आपूर्ति हासिल करने के कूटनीतिक प्रयासों को रेखांकित करता है।
bullet_points: यूक्रेनी राष्ट्रपति ज़ेलेंस्की ने कहा कि अमेरिकी मिसाइलें मिलने पर यूक्रेन रूसी तेल रिफाइनरियों पर हमले रोक देगा।
यह प्रस्ताव सैन्य लक्ष्य चयन को विदेशी रक्षा आपूर्ति समझौतों से जोड़ता है।
यूक्रेनी हमलों का मुख्य लक्ष्य रूस की तेल रिफाइनिंग क्षमता को प्रभावित करना रहा है।
ऊर्जा बुनियादी ढांचे पर हमलों का उद्देश्य रूस के तेल निर्यात राजस्व को कम करना है।
कीव ने लगातार पश्चिमी सहयोगियों, विशेषकर अमेरिका से लंबी दूरी की मिसाइल क्षमताओं की मांग की है।
key_facts: यूक्रेन के राष्ट्रपति: वोलोडिमिर ज़ेलेंस्की।
मुख्य शर्त: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका द्वारा लंबी दूरी की मिसाइलों की आपूर्ति।
निशाने पर मौजूद क्षेत्र: रूसी कच्चा तेल रिफाइनरी ढांचा।

static_gk: Reserve Bank of India (RBI): Established on April 1, 1935, under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

news.headline: Expert Warns of Inflation Risks Amid Disparity Between Bank Credit Growth and GDP Growth, Urges RBI Intervention
news.story_lead: An economics professor has highlighted significant risks regarding domestic inflation over currency depreciation, drawing attention to a disparity where bank credit growth is expanding at 19% compared to nominal GDP growth of 10%. The academic urged the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to take measures to rein in bank credit growth.
news.full_article_text:
### Disparity Between Bank Credit and GDP Growth

A notable economic warning has been issued highlighting a growing imbalance between bank credit expansion and overall economic growth in India. Data indicates that bank credit growth has reached 19%, significantly outpacing the nominal Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth rate of 10%.

### Inflation Risks vs Rupee Depreciation

Addressing the implications of this monetary gap, an economics professor emphasized that the primary concern arising from rapid credit expansion is elevated domestic inflation rather than exchange rate fluctuations or rupee risk. Unregulated or excessive credit growth can stimulate demand beyond supply capacities, leading to inflationary pressures in the economy.

### Recommendation for RBI Action

To mitigate potential macroeconomic instability and control persistent inflationary risks, the expert urged the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to intervene and rein in bank credit growth. Calibrating credit flow is seen as critical for balancing economic expansion with price stability.
bullet_points: Bank credit growth in India has reached 19%, compared to nominal GDP growth of 10%.
An economics professor highlighted that excess credit expansion poses a greater threat to domestic inflation than to rupee stability.
The expert called upon the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to rein in rapid bank credit expansion.
A significant gap between credit growth and GDP growth can fuel price rise by boosting aggregate demand beyond output capacity.
Monetary intervention by the central bank is advised to ensure price stability.
key_facts: Bank credit growth rate: 19%
Nominal GDP growth rate: 10%
Primary risk flagged: Domestic inflation over rupee depreciation
Regulatory body urged to take action: Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
exam_relevance: Prelims: Core macroeconomic indicators, bank credit growth vs GDP growth, RBI's monetary policy tools.
Mains (GS-III Economy): Monetary policy transmission, inflation management, credit control mechanisms, and financial sector regulation.
news.upsc_analysis: The mismatch between credit growth (19%) and GDP growth (10%) signals potential over-expansion of liquidity in the economy. For competitive examinations, understanding how excessive credit creates demand-pull inflation and the regulatory measures available to the RBI (such as repo rate adjustments, Cash Reserve Ratio, Statutory Liquidity Ratio, and macroprudential measures) forms a crucial part of Indian Economy studies under GS-III.
causes: Rapid expansion of bank credit outpacing the growth rate of overall economic output (GDP).
impacts: Increased risk of domestic demand-driven inflation.
Potential over-heating in liquidity-sensitive economic sectors.
challenges: Balancing adequate credit availability for productive economic activities while preventing excess liquidity from driving inflation.
government_steps: Recommendation for the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to step in and regulate the pace of credit growth.
constitutional_or_policy_link: Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 - Regulatory framework governing central banking functions, monetary policy, and credit control.
way_forward: The central bank may employ qualitative and quantitative credit control measures to ensure credit growth aligns sustainably with real and nominal economic expansion.

Bank Credit vs GDP Growth Disparity:
- Credit growth rate: 19%
- GDP growth rate: 10%
- Risk Assessment: Domestic inflation risk outweighs exchange rate (rupee) depreciation risk.
- Regulatory Action: Call for RBI intervention to moderate bank credit growth and anchor inflationary expectations.

Distinguish between domestic inflation risks and external exchange rate risks in an emerging market economy. How can central bank policy balance price stability with sustained growth?

hindi_translation.headline: बैंक क्रेडिट वृद्धि और जीडीपी वृद्धि में विषमता पर विशेषज्ञ ने दी मुद्रास्फीति की चेतावनी, आरबीआई से क्रेडिट पर लगाम लगाने का आग्रह
hindi_translation.story_lead: एक अर्थशास्त्र के प्रोफेसर ने घरेलू मुद्रास्फीति के खतरों को मुद्रा के अवमूल्यन से अधिक गंभीर बताते हुए ध्यान आकर्षित किया है। आंकड़े दर्शाते हैं कि बैंक ऋण वृद्धि 19% है जबकि नाममात्र जीडीपी वृद्धि 10% है। विशेषज्ञ ने भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (आरबीआई) से बैंक ऋण वृद्धि को नियंत्रित करने का आग्रह किया है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### बैंक ऋण और जीडीपी वृद्धि के बीच विषमता

भारत में बैंक ऋण विस्तार और समग्र आर्थिक वृद्धि के बीच बढ़ते असंतुलन को रेखांकित करते हुए एक महत्वपूर्ण आर्थिक चेतावनी जारी की गई है। आंकड़ों से पता चलता है कि बैंक ऋण वृद्धि 19% तक पहुंच गई है, जो कि 10% की नाममात्र सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (जीडीपी) वृद्धि दर से काफी अधिक है।

### मुद्रास्फीति का जोखिम बनाम रुपये का अवमूल्यन

इस मौद्रिक अंतर के निहितार्थों पर चर्चा करते हुए, अर्थशास्त्र के प्रोफेसर ने जोर देकर कहा कि तीव्र ऋण विस्तार से उत्पन्न होने वाली प्राथमिक चिंता विनिमय दर में उतार-चढ़ाव या रुपये के जोखिम के बजाय उच्च घरेलू मुद्रास्फीति है। अनियंत्रित या अत्यधिक ऋण वृद्धि आपूर्ति क्षमताओं से परे मांग को बढ़ावा दे सकती है, जिससे अर्थव्यवस्था में मुद्रास्फीति का दबाव बनता है।

### आरबीआई कार्रवाई की सिफारिश

संभावित मैक्रोइकॉनॉमिक अस्थिरता को कम करने और निरंतर मुद्रास्फीति के जोखिमों को नियंत्रित करने के लिए, विशेषज्ञ ने भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (आरबीआई) से हस्तक्षेप करने और बैंक ऋण वृद्धि पर लगाम लगाने का आग्रह किया। मूल्य स्थिरता के साथ आर्थिक विस्तार को संतुलित करने के लिए ऋण प्रवाह को उचित स्तर पर लाना महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है।
bullet_points: भारत में बैंक ऋण वृद्धि 19% पर पहुंच गई है, जबकि नाममात्र जीडीपी वृद्धि 10% है।
अर्थशास्त्र के प्रोफेसर ने रेखांकित किया कि अत्यधिक ऋण विस्तार रुपये की स्थिरता की तुलना में घरेलू मुद्रास्फीति के लिए अधिक खतरा पैदा करता है।
विशेषज्ञ ने भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (आरबीआई) से तीव्र बैंक ऋण विस्तार को नियंत्रित करने का आह्वान किया।
ऋण वृद्धि और जीडीपी वृद्धि के बीच बड़ा अंतर उत्पादन क्षमता से परे कुल मांग को बढ़ाकर कीमतों में वृद्धि को बढ़ावा दे सकता है।
मूल्य स्थिरता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए केंद्रीय बैंक द्वारा मौद्रिक हस्तक्षेप की सलाह दी गई है।
key_facts: बैंक ऋण वृद्धि दर: 19%
नाममात्र जीडीपी वृद्धि दर: 10%
प्रमुख जोखिम: रुपये के अवमूल्यन से अधिक घरेलू मुद्रास्फीति

### ISRO NVS-03 Orbit-Raising Operations

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has accomplished the first orbit-raising manoeuvre for the NVS-03 navigation satellite. Following the planned propulsion burn, ground controllers confirmed that the satellite's health parameters and subsystems are in normal condition.

* **Spacecraft Status**: All parameters and onboard systems of NVS-03 are healthy and operating as expected.

### इसरो का NVS-03 कक्षा संवर्धन ऑपरेशन

भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO) ने NVS-03 नेविगेशन उपग्रह की कक्षा को ऊपर उठाने का पहला पैंतरा (Orbit-Raising Manoeuvre) सफलतापूर्वक पूरा किया है। निर्धारित थ्रस्टर बर्न के बाद, ग्राउंड कंट्रोलर्स ने पुष्टि की कि उपग्रह के स्वास्थ्य मानक और सभी उप-प्रणालियां सामान्य रूप से कार्य कर रही हैं।
